def: The AI Act's transparency article: providers must disclose AI interaction and mark synthetic content machine-readably; deployers must disclose deepfakes, emotion recognition and AI-written public-interest text.
practice: Applies from 2 August 2026, with marking by 2 December 2026 for generative systems already on the market; the Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-generated Content (final 10 June 2026) is an accepted route to compliance (as of November 2026, not legal advice).
